drug_class: Selective T-cell costimulation modulator (CTLA-4 fusion protein)

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulant that may counteract abatacept's immunosuppressive effects and increase infection risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; patient should discontinue before starting abatacept therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Astragalus
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune stimulant may oppose therapeutic immunosuppression and reduce drug efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel patient to avoid; discontinue if currently using

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune function; monitor for adequacy of immunosuppression
caution_supplements.action: Use with monitoring; ensure no unexplained infections or loss of disease control

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Modulates immune function; deficiency may worsen RA outcomes
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; supplementation may be beneficial but should be tracked

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: No direct CYP450 interaction, but may affect gut immunity; theoretical concern only
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance required; monitor if excessive consumption

monitoring_notes: Abatacept is a biologic with no significant CYP450 metabolism; primary concern is immunostimulatory supplements that counteract its T-cell suppressive effects. Monitor for infections and loss of disease control, particularly if immunostimulating supplements are used concurrently.
